originalTitle: What Are Starbucks Stock Bulls Not Worried About?
summary: Investors are pricing Starbucks (SBUX) stock at 55.7 times its earnings over the last twelve months, well above the 22.7 multiple for the S&P 500. content:
Investors are pricing Starbucks (SBUX) stock at 55.7 times its earnings over the last twelve months , well above the 22.7 multiple for the S&P 500. That premium suggests a bet that U.S. customer visits will keep rising and profit will continue its recovery. The company delivered a fourth straight quarter of comparable sales growth in fiscal Q3 2026. Yet executives used the accompanying earnings call to acknowledge pressure on U.S. consumer sentiment. So what is that pressure?

Image by Adam Evertsson from Pixabay

Starbucks Flags Pressure On US Consumers

During that July 29, 2026 call, management maintained that the business remains strong despite continued pressure on U.S. consumer sentiment. The company acknowledged the year-over-year traffic comparisons it will lap, as well as broader variability in consumer behavior. Starbucks also faced a question on the call about how long it can sustain its current same-store sales momentum.

So far, U.S. customers are still walking through the doors more often. U.S. transactions climbed 4.2% from a year earlier in fiscal Q3 2026. Starbucks is not leaning on menu hikes either, with management noting that pricing added less than one point to the average ticket.

How Much Of Starbucks Depends On North America?

The short answer is most of it. The North America segment, encompassing U.S. and Canadian stores, generated $7.4 billion of Starbucks’s $9.3 billion in revenue during fiscal Q3 2026. Comparable store sales there grew 8.1%, outpacing the 5.7% growth at international company-operated stores. So the region facing consumer pressure is also the one growing faster.

Shareholders are paying a steep premium for that growth. At the end of June 2026, Starbucks’s P/E ratio sat higher than its level at 33 of the 37 quarter-ends with a P/E on record since fiscal Q4 2016. The shares closed on October 15, 2026, 10.7% below their highest close of the past year, reached on August 26, 2026.

Profitability has yet to fully rebound. Over the twelve months ending in June 2026, Starbucks posted an operating margin of 10.1% on our adjusted basis, compared to 15.1% two years earlier. The current share price appears to assume those margins will keep recovering. The latest quarter partly supports that outlook: the operating margin improved to 12.9% in fiscal Q3 2026 on the same basis, up from 9.5% a year earlier.

How Worried Should Starbucks Holders Be?

Investors should treat a weaker U.S. consumer as a real but slowly developing risk. Management has acknowledged the issue, yet it has not actually materialized in U.S. store visits. The current stock price appears to assume U.S. store visits keep rising.

One strong quarter of margin gains, following a much smaller year-over-year improvement in fiscal Q2, offers limited visibility into the future, and management’s own forecast sets a lower bar. Starbucks expects U.S. comparable sales growth of 6.5% or better in fiscal Q4 2026, down from 7.9% in fiscal Q3.

In September, Starbucks cut its fiscal 2026 net new store target to about 440 from 600 to 650 and said it will close about 250 underperforming North America coffeehouses, with roughly $300 million in restructuring charges and most closures due by the end of fiscal 2026.

Starbucks shares fell further than the S&P 500 in each of the four most recent market shocks with figures on record. That included a 40% slide during the 2022 inflation shock, compared to about a 24% decline for the broader index.

U.S. customer visits are still rising, but the margin recovery is less proven, with just one strong quarter on the books and part of that gain coming from one-time tariff refunds. U.S. transaction growth and operating margin remain the key metrics to watch when Starbucks delivers its next report for fiscal Q4 2026.

chineseTitle: 星巴克股票多头不担心什么？
chineseSummary: 投资者对星巴克 (SBUX) 股票的定价为过去 12 个月市盈率的 55.7 倍，远高于标准普尔 500 指数的 22.7 倍。这一溢价表明他们押注美国客户访问量将继续上升，利润将继续复苏。该公司在 2026 财年第三季度连续第四个季度实现可比销售额增长。然而，高管们在随后的财报电话会议上承认美国消费者信心面临压力。那么这个压力是什么呢。
chineseContent:
投资者对星巴克 (SBUX) 股票的定价为过去 12 个月市盈率的 55.7 倍，远高于标准普尔 500 指数的 22.7 倍。这一溢价表明他们押注美国客户访问量将继续上升，利润将继续复苏。该公司在 2026 财年第三季度连续第四个季度实现可比销售额增长。然而，高管们在随后的财报电话会议上承认美国消费者信心面临压力。那么这个压力是什么呢？

该图片由Adam Evertsson在Pixabay上发布

星巴克对美国消费者施加压力

在 2026 年 7 月 29 日的电话会议中，管理层坚称，尽管美国消费者信心持续面临压力，但业务依然强劲。该公司承认其将进行同比流量比较，以及消费者行为的更广泛变化。星巴克在电话会议上还面临一个问题，即其目前的同店销售势头能够维持多久。

到目前为止，美国顾客进店的次数仍然较多。 2026 财年第三季度，美国交易量同比增长 4.2%。星巴克也不打算提高菜单价格，管理层指出，定价使平均票价增加了不到一个百分点。

像这样的风险考验着每一个退休计划。如果您的顾问最近退休，那么现在是向我们的合作伙伴公司免费提供第二意见的好时机。

星巴克在多大程度上依赖于北美？

简短的回答是大部分。星巴克在 2026 年第三季度的收入为 93 亿美元，其中包括美国和加拿大门店的北美业务创造了 74 亿美元的收入。该地区的可比门店销售额增长了 8.1%，超过了国际公司自营门店 5.7% 的增长。因此，面临消费压力的地区也是增长较快的地区。

股东为这种增长付出了高昂的溢价。截至 2026 年 6 月末，星巴克的市盈率在 37 个季度末中有 33 个季度高于其水平，自 2016 财年第四季度以来的市盈率创历史新高。该股于 2026 年 10 月 15 日收盘，较 2026 年 8 月 26 日创下的去年最高收盘价低 10.7%。

盈利能力尚未完全反弹。截至 2026 年 6 月的 12 个月中，根据我们调整后的数据，星巴克的营业利润率为 10.1%，而两年前为 15.1%。目前的股价似乎假设这些利润率将继续恢复。最新季度在一定程度上支持了这一前景：在相同基础上，2026 财年第三季度的营业利润率从去年同期的 9.5% 升至 12.9%。

星巴克持有者应该有多担心？

投资者应将美国消费者疲软视为真正但缓慢发展的风险。管理层已经承认了这个问题，但实际上并没有在美国商店走访中体现出来。目前的股价似乎假设美国商店的客流量持续上升。

在第二财季同比改善幅度小得多之后，一个季度的利润率增长强劲，对未来的可见性有限，管理层自己的预测设定了较低的标准。星巴克预计 2026 财年第四季度美国可比销售额增长 6.5% 或更高，低于第三财季的 7.9%。

9月，星巴克将2026财年净新店目标从600家削减至650家左右，并表示将关闭约250家表现不佳的北美咖啡馆，重组费用约为3亿美元，大部分关闭将于2026财年年底前关闭。

在最近四次创纪录的市场冲击中，星巴克股价的跌幅均超过标准普尔 500 指数。其中包括 2022 年通胀冲击期间下跌 40%，而整体指数下跌约 24%。

美国的客户访问量仍在上升，但利润率的复苏尚未得到证实，只有一个季度表现强劲，其中部分收益来自一次性关税退款。星巴克发布 2026 年第四季度财报时，美国交易增长和营业利润率仍然是值得关注的关键指标。
